annotations.annotation_text: Satirical and biographical presence of Jonathan Swift (swift): Dean of St. Patrick's Cathedral, his dual lovers Stella and Vanessa (mirroring Issy), and his ferocious political satires.

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic discourse on page 450: Joyce weaves multilingual puns, etymological roots, and rhythmic cadences capturing the shifting consciousness of the collective unconscious.
sources: Tindall, William York. A Reader's Guide to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/readersguidetofi00tind
